# AI News

> A public daily intelligence publication covering AI, science, open-source tools, capital, culture, and world signals. Every item links back to its primary source where available.

Canonical Chinese index: https://gyread.com/news/
Canonical English index: https://gyread.com/news/en/
Chinese RSS: https://gyread.com/news/feed.xml
English RSS: https://gyread.com/news/en/feed.xml
Sitemap: https://gyread.com/news/sitemap.xml
Source repository: https://github.com/gengyueworks/ai-news

## Use

- Reading, search indexing, citation, and linking are welcome.
- Cite the article title and link to the canonical page.
- Do not republish full editions, bulk-mirror the archive, or resell the compilation without written permission.
- Images remain subject to the rights and terms of their original sources. The source line is part of the editorial record and should remain visible.
- Machine-readable preference: search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=no.
